purpose: Continue the three-session offline research program after Campaign008 failed its frozen no-return coverage gate. This record considers only economic meaning and accepted source-schema feasibility, rejects terminal or near-synonym mechanisms before values, and selects at most one concept for a separate exact no-value overlap audit.

concepts_rejected_before_formula_or_valu.reason: Campaign008 is terminal. Treating a one-sided zero as inactive, filling it, changing the volume transform, lag, threshold, or window would be prohibited rescue.
The standalone 09:30 record can be a zero-activity reference placeholder, and opening-gap mechanisms are already terminal.
Signed path efficiency, diffusive variation ratio, return-sign runs, price-update share, and related between-close path mechanisms are terminal.
Upside semivariance, variance entropy, skewness, realized volatility, and volatility-resolution mechanisms are terminal.
Amount/volume-weighted close pressure, absorption, price impact, and activity-volatility coupling are terminal and cannot be revived through OHLC additions.
Conditioning on upside/downside wick or candle sign risks reopening directional absorption and signed-path families. The selected concept must remain sign-symmetric.

selected_concept.mechanism: Measure how much of the price range explored inside one-minute bars is retained as absolute open-to-close displacement. This is a sign-neutral within-bar auction-efficiency question based on OHLC extrema, not a between-bar return path, activity response, volume profile, market benchmark, or transaction-price construction.
selected_concept.economic_question: Do stock-days whose minute-level excursions more often resolve into directional price discovery, rather than transient intrabar rejection, carry information from the next open through the third close?
known_design_risks: body and range transforms, aggregation, direction, zero-range handling, timestamp grid, and minimum active bars create researcher degrees of freedom unless frozen before values
raw OHLC ordering must be validated fail-closed rather than repaired
a signed or wick-specific version would overlap terminal directional mechanisms
a between-bar variant would overlap terminal close-path efficiency mechanisms
the candidate may still be statistically redundant even if its economic measurement level is distinct

decision.required_next_step: Perform a separate no-value audit against all 32 prior terminal mechanisms. Only if the concept remains economically distinct may that audit freeze one exact formula, one direction, OHLC ordering and zero-range semantics, no-return gates, and one finite trial before candidate or comparison values or returns are read.
